devdoc.details: ERC20 token contract with liquidity pool balancing functionality Features: - Whitelist management for exempt addresses - Sell tax mechanism - Transfer restrictions from/to liquidity pool - Automatic liquidity pool balancing

ERC20InsufficientAllowance(address,uint2.details: Indicates a failure with the `spender`’s `allowance`. Used in transfers.

params.allowance: Amount of tokens a `spender` is allowed to operate with.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC20InsufficientBalance(address,uint256.details: Indicates an error related to the current `balance` of a `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.balance: Current balance for the interacting account.
params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidApprover(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `approver` of a token to be approved. Used in approvals.

ERC20InvalidReceiver(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `receiver`. Used in transfers.

params.receiver: Address to which tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC20InvalidSpender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `spender` to be approved. Used in approvals.

params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`). Note that `value` may be zero.

addWhitelist(address).details: Add an address to the whitelist

params._addr: Address to add to whitelist Whitelisted addresses are exempt from transfer restrictions and sell taxes

allowance(address,address).details: Returns the remaining number of tokens that `spender` will be allowed to spend on behalf of `owner` through {transferFrom}. This is zero by default. This value changes when {approve} or {transferFrom} are called.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the value of tokens owned by `account`.

balancePool().details: Balance the liquidity pool by burning a percentage of pool's tokens This function: 1. Calculates the burn amount based on targetRatio 2. Burns tokens from the pool by sending them to DEAD address 3. Syncs the PancakeSwap pair to update reserves  Requirements: - targetRatio must be less than 500 (5%) - Only callable by governance

constructor.details: Constructor - Initializes the token contract Sets initial sell tax to 3% (300 basis points) Sets initial target ratio to 1% (100 basis points) Sets deployer as initial governance and fee receiver

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5.05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the default value returned by this function, unless it's overridden. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

mint(address,uint256).details: Mint new tokens to a specified address

params._amount: Amount of tokens to mint  Requirements: - Only callable by treasury address
params._to: Address to receive the minted tokens

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

removeWhitelist(address).details: Remove an address from the whitelist

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params._newReceiver: Address that will receive sell tax fees

params._newTaxRate: New sell tax rate in basis points (0-3000, where 3000 = 30%) This tax is applied when tokens are sold to the liquidity pool

setTargetPool(address).details: Set the target liquidity pool address

params._newPool: Address of the liquidity pool (e.g., PancakeSwap pair) This address is used for transfer restrictions and pool balancing

setTargetRatio(uint256).details: Set the target ratio for pool balancing

params._newRatio: New target ratio in basis points (0-500, where 500 = 5%) This ratio determines how much of the pool's token balance will be burned during balancePool()

setTransferState(bool).details: Enable or disable transfers from the liquidity pool

params._enable: True to enable transfers from pool, false to disable When disabled, only whitelisted addresses and DEAD address can receive tokens from pool

params._newTreasury: Address of the treasury Treasury address is authorized to mint new tokens

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

totalSupply().details: Returns the value of tokens in existence.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Skips emitting an {Approval} event indicating an allowance update. This is not required by the ERC. See {xref-ERC20-_approve-address-address-uint256-bool-}[_approve]. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

transferGovernance(address).details: Transfer governance to a new address

params._newGovernance: Address of the new governance This transfers all administrative control to the new address

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

feeReceiver.details: Address that receives sell tax fees

governance.details: Governance address that controls contract parameters

sellRatio.details: Sell tax ratio (in basis points, max 3000 = 30%)

targetPool.details: Target liquidity pool address (e.g., PancakeSwap pair)

targetRatio.details: Target ratio for pool balancing (in basis points, max 500 = 5%)

transferStatus.details: Transfer status flag - when false, transfers from pool are disabled

treasury.details: Treasury address authorized to mint tokens

whitelist.details: Mapping of whitelisted addresses exempt from transfer restrictions

ERC20InvalidReceiver(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `receiver`. Used in transfers.

params.balance: Current balance for the interacting account.

ERC20InsufficientBalance(address,uint256.details: Indicates an error related to the current `balance` of a `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.needed: Minimum amount required to perform a transfer.
params.spender: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.
params.allowance: Amount of tokens a `spender` is allowed to operate with.

ERC20InsufficientAllowance(address,uint2.details: Indicates a failure with the `spender`’s `allowance`. Used in transfers.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to another (`to`). Note that `value` may be zero.

devdoc.details: ERC20 token contract with liquidity pool balancing functionality Features: - Whitelist management for exempt addresses - Sell tax mechanism - Transfer restrictions from/to liquidity pool - Automatic liquidity pool balancing

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5.05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the default value returned by this function, unless it's overridden. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

constructor.details: Constructor - Initializes the token contract Sets initial sell tax to 3% (300 basis points) Sets initial target ratio to 1% (100 basis points) Sets deployer as initial governance and fee receiver

balancePool().details: Balance the liquidity pool by burning a percentage of pool's tokens This function: 1. Calculates the burn amount based on targetRatio 2. Burns tokens from the pool by sending them to DEAD address 3. Syncs the PancakeSwap pair to update reserves  Requirements: - targetRatio must be less than 500 (5%) - Only callable by governance

totalSupply().details: Returns the value of tokens in existence.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the value of tokens owned by `account`.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params._newTreasury: Address of the treasury Treasury address is authorized to mint new tokens

params._addr: Address to add to whitelist Whitelisted addresses are exempt from transfer restrictions and sell taxes

addWhitelist(address).details: Add an address to the whitelist

params._to: Address to receive the minted tokens
params._amount: Amount of tokens to mint  Requirements: - Only callable by treasury address

mint(address,uint256).details: Mint new tokens to a specified address

params._newTaxRate: New sell tax rate in basis points (0-3000, where 3000 = 30%) This tax is applied when tokens are sold to the liquidity pool

params._newPool: Address of the liquidity pool (e.g., PancakeSwap pair) This address is used for transfer restrictions and pool balancing

setTargetPool(address).details: Set the target liquidity pool address

params._enable: True to enable transfers from pool, false to disable When disabled, only whitelisted addresses and DEAD address can receive tokens from pool

setTransferState(bool).details: Enable or disable transfers from the liquidity pool

params._newReceiver: Address that will receive sell tax fees

params._newRatio: New target ratio in basis points (0-500, where 500 = 5%) This ratio determines how much of the pool's token balance will be burned during balancePool()

setTargetRatio(uint256).details: Set the target ratio for pool balancing

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

removeWhitelist(address).details: Remove an address from the whitelist

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

allowance(address,address).details: Returns the remaining number of tokens that `spender` will be allowed to spend on behalf of `owner` through {transferFrom}. This is zero by default. This value changes when {approve} or {transferFrom} are called.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._newGovernance: Address of the new governance This transfers all administrative control to the new address

transferGovernance(address).details: Transfer governance to a new address

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Skips emitting an {Approval} event indicating an allowance update. This is not required by the ERC. See {xref-ERC20-_approve-address-address-uint256-bool-}[_approve]. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

treasury.details: Treasury address authorized to mint tokens

sellRatio.details: Sell tax ratio (in basis points, max 3000 = 30%)

whitelist.details: Mapping of whitelisted addresses exempt from transfer restrictions

governance.details: Governance address that controls contract parameters

targetPool.details: Target liquidity pool address (e.g., PancakeSwap pair)

feeReceiver.details: Address that receives sell tax fees

targetRatio.details: Target ratio for pool balancing (in basis points, max 500 = 5%)

transferStatus.details: Transfer status flag - when false, transfers from pool are disabled
